value.value: Dark, bare-glass, fresh-NC-film glass and the same film aged11 weeks are compared. NC-film photocurrent is about an order of magnitude above bare glass and approximately four orders above dark current. Aging lowers it nearly threefold but leaves it above reference. No precise absolute current or device efficiency is inferred from the curves.

value.value: Photocurrent proof-of-concept.  Schematic and dark/bare/fresh/11weekaged curves; unencapsulated deposited film. C12: Figure9 says embedded NCs but methods specify a deposited NC film and main10 explicitly unencapsulated. No polymer/protective matrix preparation is supplied; retain actual deposited-film scope. G3: Five preparation labels are supported, but independent batch counts, exact aliquot sharing across measurements, deposition thicknesses and every stability/LSC sample loading label are not supplied. A common material family is not proof of the same specimen.
